_doc: EBL OS 数据集的事实清单：每一条都是可以被查询证伪的 claim。改数据前先改这里，否则闸门绿着而故事已经变了。来源 client/team-2/11 亿营收目标与防御性毛利守护方案.MD
name: ebl_ops

tables.name: customers
tables.why: 11 亿 / 年均 610 万 ≈ 180 家；客户数少于核心客户流失才可测

tables.name: products
tables.why: 四档 × 镜架/镜片/配件（§四 三档定价 + §三 微改良）

tables.name: production_lines
tables.why: §八 关停/合并最低效产线需要有可数的产线；7 条利用率 <70%（§四 低毛利订单唯一去处）

tables.name: suppliers
tables.why: §八 前 10 大供应商集中议价

tables.name: employees
tables.why: §二 约 2800 人，6 个部门

tables.name: core_customers
tables.why: §七 核心客户清单 Q1 锁定；12 家才让『流失 ≤2 家』有区分度

tables.name: micro_improvements
tables.why: §三 微改良 3–5 个 + §四 认证 1–2 项

tables.name: opex_items
tables.why: §八 行政部冻结非生产性支出，出清单

tables.name: leads
tables.why: §七 新客只考核有效询盘数；§三 只走转介绍/展会存量转化

tables.name: order_lines
tables.why: 每单 4 行：营收/毛利/档位/增长来源都落在这层

tables.name: low_margin_approvals
tables.why: §四 双签 + 提成减半 + 6 个月复审的落地凭证

tables.name: order_adjustments
tables.why: 折扣/返利：让订单头与行合计差 1.5%（两套营收口径的病理）

tables.name: rule_regimes
tables.why: §六 第 1/2/3/4 周的制度切换点

invariants.why: §一 年度营收目标 11 亿
invariants.sql: SELECT round(sum(ol.revenue)/1e8, 3) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026

invariants.why: §一 去年营收 9 亿（增量才有意义）
invariants.sql: SELECT round(sum(ol.revenue)/1e8, 3) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2025
SELECT o.quarter, round(sum(ol.revenue)/1e8, 2) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

invariants.why: §一/§四 加权毛利目标 18–19%（按营收加权，不是行平均）
invariants.sql: SELECT round(sum(ol.revenue*ol.gross_margin)/sum(ol.revenue), 3) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026

invariants.why: §四 季度预警线 17%：任一季破线即红
invariants.sql: SELECT min(m) FROM (SELECT sum(ol.revenue*ol.gross_margin)/sum(ol.revenue) AS m FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 GROUP BY o.quarter) s

invariants.why: §四 差异化品 25–28%
invariants.sql: SELECT round(avg(ol.gross_margin), 2) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.tier = '差异化'
SELECT round(avg(ol.gross_margin), 2) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.tier = '标准'

invariants.why: §四 低毛利走量 13–16%
invariants.sql: SELECT round(avg(ol.gross_margin), 2) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.tier = '低毛利走量'
SELECT round(avg(ol.gross_margin), 2) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.tier = '微改良'

invariants.why: §四 低毛利订单占比 ≤25%（约 2.75 亿）
invariants.sql: SELECT round(100.0*sum(ol.revenue) FILTER (WHERE ol.tier = '低毛利走量')/sum(ol.revenue), 2) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026

invariants.why: §四 低毛利订单只喂利用率 <70% 的产线（违规必须为 0）
invariants.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id JOIN production_lines pl ON pl.id = ol.production_line_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.tier = '低毛利走量' AND pl.utilization >= 70

invariants.why: §四 低毛利订单必须双签（缺一条就是治理失效）
invariants.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id LEFT JOIN low_margin_approvals a ON a.id = ol.approval_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.tier = '低毛利走量' AND (a.id IS NULL OR a.signed_by_sales IS NULL OR a.signed_by_finance IS NULL)

invariants.why: §三/§四 认证溢价只挂微改良产品，且 ∈[2,3]%
invariants.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.certification_premium IS NOT NULL AND (ol.tier <> '微改良' OR ol.certification_premium NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 3)

invariants.why: §四 B 新客户 0.6–0.8 亿
invariants.sql: SELECT round(sum(ol.revenue)/1e8, 3) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.growth_bucket = 'B 新客户'

invariants.why: §四 C 微改良 0.3–0.4 亿
invariants.sql: SELECT round(sum(ol.revenue)/1e8, 3) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.growth_bucket = 'C 微改良'

invariants.why: §四 A 老客户加购 0.2–0.3 亿
invariants.sql: SELECT round(sum(ol.revenue)/1e8, 3) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026 AND ol.growth_bucket = 'A 老客户加购'

invariants.why: §一 核心客户流失 ≤2 家
invariants.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM core_customers cc WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.customer_id = cc.customer_id AND o.fiscal_year = 2025) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.customer_id = cc.customer_id AND o.fiscal_year = 2026)
SELECT count(*) FROM employees

invariants.why: §十 不通过裁员快速降本
invariants.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM employees WHERE leave_reason = '裁员'

invariants.why: 订单头与行合计只差折扣/返利，不是两个故事（§四 两套口径必须可解释）
invariants.sql: SELECT round(100.0*abs(sum(o.revenue_header) - sum(l.s)) / sum(l.s), 2) FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id, sum(revenue) AS s FROM order_lines GROUP BY 1) l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.fiscal_year = 2026

invariants.why: §三 新客只走转介绍和展会存量转化，不做陌拜
invariants.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE entered_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND source_channel NOT IN ('转介绍','展会存量转化')

constant_columns.why: 全部订单同一币种（RMB）：任何『按币种换算/多币种』的口径都不可能在本数据集上成立，本体应按名拒绝

null_rates.why: §六 数据质量差：到年底仍有一部分客户未完成分级
新客户/停止合作客户没有回款记录
至少一家供应商账期未记录
